results.content: X-Nav consists of two learning stages: 1) multiple expert policies are trained using deep reinforcement learning with privileged observations on a wide range of randomly generated robot embodiments; and 2) a single general policy is distilled from the expert policies via navigation action chunking with transformer (Nav-ACT). An overview of X-Nav. X-Nav trains a single end-to-end general navigation policy using randomly generated robot embodiments, which achieves zero-shot transfer to a variety of unseen wheeled and quadrupedal robots in simulated and real-world environments.
